description: Order of the declared account in state PENDING PAYMENT (class ApprovalRoutings, AR- number), the account owning between min and max such orders on the store. Outputs: orderNumber, orderDate, total, pendingPaymentCount, first number asc/desc. Read only.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the pending-payment order: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

minPendingPayments.description: Pending-payment orders the account must own on the store (at least; 9 for a second 8-row page)

maxPendingPayments.description: Most pending-payment orders allowed, e.g. the page size so all fit one page. Left out: no upper bound

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
